title: rosa × collina var. cinerea
intro: Rosa × collina var. cinerea, commonly known as Rosa rugosa 'Cinerea', is a variety of flowering plant that belongs to the family Rosaceae. It is a shrub with fragrant, pink flowers and edible hips, which are rich in vitamins, minerals, and antioxidants. The health benefits of Rosa rugosa 'Cinerea' include its potential to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial effects.
